risks.reasoning: For FY2021, the audited cash flow statement reports net cash used in operating activities of HK$49,730 thousand and cash and cash equivalents at year end of HK$14,485 thousand. Monthly operating cash burn is approximately HK$4,144 thousand and cash runway is approximately 3.50 months, below the 6-month high threshold and at or above the 3-month critical threshold.

The accountants' report shows profit for the year of HK$25,219 thousand, HK$29,858 thousand and HK$24,003 thousand for FY2019, FY2020 and FY2021 respectively. There are zero comparable loss periods, so the continuous-loss condition is not met.

Revenue increased from HK$475,308 thousand in FY2020 to HK$534,302 thousand in FY2021, an increase of approximately 12.41%. The latest comparable growth is positive and does not trigger the frozen negative-growth thresholds.

For FY2021, the largest customer accounted for 22.1% and the five largest customers accounted for 47.4% of total revenue. Both ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%, respectively.

For FY2021, the largest supplier accounted for 14.4% and the five largest suppliers accounted for 54.4% of total purchases. Both disclosed ratios remain below the frozen medium thresholds of 30% and 60%, respectively.

DHQ and Kallo made Pre-IPO Investments and DHQ was granted a put option and rights of first refusal that were contingent on the Listing not being consummated by December 31, 2023. The formal Pre-IPO disclosure states that no special rights were granted to the Pre-IPO Investors that will survive the Listing, so the put/redemption-style rights terminate on consummation of the Global Offering without a disclosed restoration condition.

The formal Compliance and Legal Proceedings section states that all material licences, permits and approvals were obtained and valid, and that the Group had not been materially penalised. The disclosed historical non-compliances, including late tax filings and partial social insurance and housing provident fund contributions, were remediated, indemnified by Controlling Shareholders, and assessed by the Directors as not material to operations; no material pending litigation was disclosed.

The Business and History section describes a leading Macau IT solutions company operating since 2010 with substantial revenue from professional IT services, managed services, distribution and resale. The core services are already commercialized and revenue-generating; this is not a precommercial product-development issuer.
